Moving on to the next slide, let's take a look at revenue growth and EBITDA margin by geography. [#199](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-199)
Solid top line growth also generated some operating leverage helping margin progression. [#156](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-156)
Could you talk about how pricing has developed as a component of organic growth relative to Q1? [#362](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-362)
So do you have any plans to invest, I guess, more than usual in certain geographies to drive higher organic growth going forward? [#613](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-613)
You see indeed a regular growth with some push from major deals while keeping the margin in a narrow bandwidth whatever happens. [#181](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-181)
Organic growth is 3.2%. [#201](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-201)
So the organic growth will be better in '27. [#524](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-524)

As expressed in the geographic split, we have Latin America and Southern Europe [indiscernible] with organic growth at 8% and 5.7% respectively, which reflects both our commercial successes while addressing the need for outsourcing and probably more dynamic economic trends. [#203](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-203)

We expect a slight expansion of both the adjusted EBITDA margin and the adjusted EBIT margin, driven by further productivity gains and the implementation of a cost saving plan, which is helping to offset the increase in certain cost inputs such as fuel linked to the Middle East conflict. [#334](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-334)

In a nutshell, looking at the growth, we keep in mind that the ForEx is very positive in LatAm, negative in U.K. So we focus on organic. [#202](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-202)
For margin, Xavier discussed the evolution per region. [#207](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-207)

Looking at geography, France represents now less than 30% of group revenue, illustrating how the rest of our footprint keeps gaining relative weight with a solid balance between mature regions such as Central Europe, U.K., Ireland, Scandinavia, Eastern Europe, and more dynamic regions such as Latin America, Southern Europe, which continue to offer strong structural growth potential. [#193](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-193)
It's a mix of more mature markets and tougher macro environments. [#206](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-206)

Scandinavia and Eastern Europe is a region made up of relatively small mature markets where the group already holds a strong market position. [#114](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-114)
The EBITDA margin improved slightly by 10 basis points to 34.5%. [#119](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-119)

So yes, I cannot just confirm that, yes, we expect a better organic growth in '27 because we will have the full effect and report effect of the [indiscernible]  plus some positive index to sustain the price increase. [#602](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-602)

Despite the very global European macro environment, this slide presents Elis organic revenue growth in H1 across a number of our European markets. [#61](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-61)

As already mentioned, we are clearly seeing these investments pay off where they have been made, and we'll come back to this in more detail as we go through geography. [#55](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-55)

And is this a sign that maybe you're feeling a bit more confident on the growth outlook for the rest of this year and into next year and therefore, driving up the CapEx as a result of that? [#408](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-408)
Adjusted EBITDA increased to EUR 853.8 million with the margin flat at 34.7%. [#212](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-212)
This strategy remains a key lever for organic growth. [#53](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-53)
Margin in France, so it's -- yes, it's not due to a lot of additional volume with operating leverage and so on. [#526](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-526)

What I expect is regarding the price effect, it will be more balanced in H2 as the opposite, we will have the full effect of loss of volume in Mexico that will put pressure on margin because we will have -- we will lose the operating leverage in Mexico. [#557](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-557)
The margin is now stabilized at a high level. [#120](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-120)
First of all, on margin, could you quantify the amount of the cost savings you are mentioning? [#455](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-455)
Adjusted EBIT rose by plus 4.6% to EUR 370 million with the margin also flat at 15.1%. [#23](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-23)

And then also, if you could clarify how fast those new contract signings, how fast they will translate into the organic growth number? [#494](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-494)

So if I take the combination of your confidence around new contract wins, coupled with your observations around pricing negotiations, it seems highly likely you'll see an acceleration in organic growth into 2027. [#509](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-509)
Reported revenue was up plus 3.4%, including plus 1.6% organic growth  -- of organic. [#115](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-115)
Adjusted EBITDA increased by 4.9% to EUR 853.8 million with margin flat year-on-year at 35.7%. [#22](https://gam.prontonlp.com/#/ref/$SENTID_T000003774119-22)
